title: Mapping frame pixels back to an overlay
description: You can follow inverse coordinates into selected pixel replacements.

steps.description: You invert H and copy scene into composite. The grid creates one homogeneous coordinate, an x-y pair with an added scale component, for every frame pixel.
Multiplying by Hinv maps frame coordinates toward the overlay. You divide by the third component and reshape the resulting x and y arrays.

steps.question: Does this assignment replace every pixel in composite?
steps.answer: No. It replaces only pixels whose mapped source coordinates pass the inside mask.

steps.description: You convert accepted source coordinates to integer indices and copy overlay colors into composite. The final calls display that result; the recording supplies no rendered figure or text output.
